description: Evaluations for testing deterministic parsing, WoW math, graceful fallbacks, and HTML Artifact generation from scheduled GA4 & GSC CSVs.

evals.name: Standard 6-Report Ingestion & Dashboard Render
evals.prompt: Here are the 6 scheduled Google Analytics 4 and Google Search Console CSV exports from this week: traffic overview, channel grouping, landing pages, search queries, device breakdown, and page engagement. Please run /weekly-analytics-report and generate my weekly dashboard Artifact.
evals.expected_output: The skill should identify all 6 CSV files, parse traffic, channels, queries, pages, devices, and engagement, calculate KPIs (sessions, users, organic clicks, CTR, position), and output a self-contained dark-mode HTML Artifact report with Chart.js charts and key findings callouts.
assertions: Detects all 6 report types without user intervention
Calculates Total Sessions, Users, and Average Session Duration accurately
Calculates weighted search position rather than arithmetic average
Renders a self-contained HTML Artifact with embedded Chart.js graphs
Displays positive/negative metrics with green/red indicator badges

evals.name: Week-over-Week Delta & Trend Comparison
evals.prompt: I have uploaded both this week's 6 CSV reports and last week's 6 CSV reports. Compare them week-over-week and tell me where our traffic growth came from, which queries gained momentum, and which pages dropped.
evals.expected_output: The skill should parse both sets of files, compute deterministic week-over-week deltas (absolute and percentage changes), identify top gaining and dropping landing pages, find queries with +10% impressions momentum, calculate the mobile device share shift, and render the complete comparative HTML dashboard Artifact.
assertions: Matches current week and prior week files by report signature
Flags top gaining landing page and sharpest dropping page
Filters search queries with +10% impressions momentum
Reports mobile vs desktop share shift in percentage points

evals.name: Resilient Partial-Data Fallback (General Movement Mode)
evals.prompt: Only 3 of my scheduled reports arrived this week: traffic_overview.csv, channel_grouping.csv, and landing_pages.csv. Search console and device breakdown are missing. Can you still generate the weekly summary?
evals.expected_output: The skill should gracefully fall back to 'General Movement' mode, process the 3 available reports, mark Search Console and Device breakdown as 'Data unavailable' in the report, and still produce a functional HTML Artifact with the available KPIs.
assertions: Does not crash or abort when 3 files are missing
Logs a warning acknowledging missing reports
Adapts the HTML layout to render available sections cleanly
Displays 'Data unavailable' badges for missing modules
